sentences.en: Hi everyone, welcome to the Snow Centre.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到雪地中心。

sentences.en: My name's Annie. hope you enjoyed the bus trip from the airport - we've certainly got plenty of snow today!
sentences.zh: 我叫安妮。希望你们 enjoyed从机场出发的巴士之旅——今天确实下了 plenty 的雪！

sentences.en: Well, you've come to New Zealand's premier snow and ski centre, and we've a whole load of activities for you during your week here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你们来到的是新西兰首屈一指的冰雪与滑雪中心，本周我们将为你们安排丰富多彩的活动。

sentences.en: Most visitors come here for the cross-country skiing, where you're on fairly flat ground for most of the time, rather than going down steep mountainsides.
sentences.zh: 大多数游客来这里是为了越野滑雪，大部分时间都在相对平坦的地面上滑行，而不是沿着陡峭的山坡向下疾驰。

sentences.en: There are marked trails, but you can also leave these and go off on your own and that's an experience not to be missed.
sentences.zh: 这里有标示清晰的滑雪道，但你也可以离开这些固定路线，独自探索，这是一次不容错过的体验。

sentences.en: You can go at your own speed - it's great aerobic exercise if you really push yourself, or if you prefer you can just glide gently along and enjoy the beautiful scenery.
sentences.zh: 你可以按自己的节奏滑行——如果全力以赴，这是极佳的有氧运动；如果你更喜欢轻松一点，也可以缓缓滑行，尽情欣赏美丽的风景。

sentences.en: This afternoon, you'll be going on a dog-sled trip.
sentences.zh: 今天下午，你们将参加一次狗拉雪橇之旅。

sentences.en: You may have seen our dogs on TV recently racing in the winter sled festival.
sentences.zh: 你们最近可能在电视上看到过我们的雪橇犬，它们刚参加了冬季雪橇节比赛。

sentences.en: If you want, you can have your own team for the afternoon and learn how to drive them, following behind our leader on the trail.
sentences.zh: 如果你想尝试，下午可以拥有一支属于自己的雪橇犬队，并学习如何驾驭它们，跟随我们的领队沿雪道前行。

sentences.en: Or if you'd prefer, you can just sit back in the sled and enjoy the ride as a passenger.
sentences.zh: 或者，如果你更愿意，也可以只是坐在雪橇上，作为乘客享受这段旅程。

sentences.en: At the weekend, we have the team relay event, and you're all welcome to join in.
sentences.zh: 周末我们将举行团队接力赛，欢迎大家踊跃参与。

sentences.en: We have a local school coming along, and a lot of the teachers are taking part too.
sentences.zh: 当地一所学校也会前来参加，许多老师也将一同加入。

sentences.en: Participation rather than winning is the main focus, and there's a medal for everyone who takes part.
sentences.zh: 本次活动重在参与而非取胜，每位参赛者都将获得一枚奖牌。

sentences.en: Participants are in teams of two to four, and each team must complete four laps of the course.
sentences.zh: 参赛者以两人至四人组成一队，每支队伍须完成赛道四圈。

sentences.en: For your final expedition, you'll head off to Mount Frenner wearing a pair of special snow shoes which allow you to walk on top of the snow.
sentences.zh: 最后的远征活动，你们将前往弗雷纳山，穿上特制的雪鞋，以便在积雪表面行走。

sentences.en: This is an area where miners once searched for gold, though there are very few traces of their work left now.
sentences.zh: 这一区域曾是矿工们淘金的地方，不过如今几乎已看不到他们当年作业的痕迹。

sentences.en: When the snow melts in summer, the mountain slopes are carpeted in flowers and plants.
sentences.zh: 夏季积雪融化后，山坡上便铺满了鲜花和植物。

sentences.en: It's a long ascent.
sentences.zh: 这是一段漫长的攀登路程。

sentences.en: though not too steep, and walkers generally take a couple of days to get to the summit and return.
sentences.zh: 虽然坡度不算太陡，但徒步者通常需要花费两天时间才能登顶并返回。

sentences.en: You'll spend the night in our hut half-way up the mountain.
sentences.zh: 你们将在半山腰的小屋中过夜。

sentences.en: That's included in your package for the stay.
sentences.zh: 这已包含在你们本次住宿的套餐之中。

sentences.en: It's got cooking facilities, firewood and water for drinking.
sentences.zh: 小屋内配有炊具、柴火和饮用水。

sentences.en: For washing, we recommend you use melted snow, though, to conserve supplies.
sentences.zh: 为了节约物资，我们建议你们用融化的雪水清洗。

sentences.en: We can take your luggage up on our snowmobile for you for just ten dollars a person.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用雪地摩托帮你们把行李运上山，每人只需十美元。

sentences.en: The hut has cooking facilities so you can make a hot meal in the evening and morning, but you need to take your own food.
sentences.zh: 小屋内配有炊具，因此你们可以在傍晚和清晨烹制热餐，但需自备食物。

sentences.en: The weather on Mount Frenner can be very stormy.
sentences.zh: 弗雷纳山的天气可能非常恶劣，常有暴风雨。

sentences.en: In that case, stay in the hut - generally the storms don't last long.
sentences.zh: 遇到这种情况，请留在小屋内——一般来说，暴风雨不会持续太久。

sentences.en: Don't stress about getting back here to the centre in time to catch the airport bus - they'll probably not be running anyway.
sentences.zh: 不必担心赶不及回到中心搭乘机场班车——那时班车很可能根本不会运行。

sentences.en: We do have an emergency locator beacon in the hut but only use that if it's a real emergency, like if someone's ill or injured.
sentences.zh: 小屋内装有紧急定位信标，但仅限真正紧急情况（例如有人生病或受伤）时使用。

sentences.en: Now, let me tell you something about the different ski trails you can follow during your stay here.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我为大家介绍一下你们在此逗留期间可选择的不同滑雪道。

sentences.en: Highland Trail's directly accessible from where we are now.
sentences.zh: 高地滑雪道就从我们目前所在位置直接通达。

sentences.en: This trail's been designed to give first-timers an experience they'll enjoy regardless of their age or skill, but it's also ideal for experts to practise their technique.
sentences.zh: 这条滑雪道专为初学者设计，无论年龄大小或技术水平高低，都能从中获得乐趣；同时它也十分适合高手练习技巧。

sentences.en: Then there's Pine Trail ... if you're nervous about skiing, leave this one to the experts!
sentences.zh: 接着是松林滑雪道……如果你对滑雪感到紧张，那就把这条道留给高手吧！

sentences.en: You follow a steep valley looking right down on the river below • scary!
sentences.zh: 你将沿着一条陡峭的山谷滑行，正下方就是河流——令人胆战心惊！

sentences.en: But if you've fully mastered the techniques needed for hills, it's great fun.
sentences.zh: 但如果你已完全掌握下坡所需的各种技巧，那这将是一次极富乐趣的体验。

sentences.en: Stony Trail's a good choice once you've got a general idea of the basics.
sentences.zh: 碎石滑雪道则适合已大致掌握滑雪基本要领之后再尝试。

sentences.en: There are one or two tricky sections, but nothing too challenging.
sentences.zh: 途中有一两处较难通过的路段，但整体并不算特别具有挑战性。

sentences.en: There's a shelter half-way where you can sit. 019 and take a break and enjoy the afternoon sunshine.
sentences.zh: 中途设有一处避风小屋，你们可以在此坐下休息，享受午后阳光。

sentences.en: And finally, Loser's Trail.
sentences.zh: 最后是‘失败者’滑雪道。

sentences.en: This starts off following a gentle river valley but the last part is quite exposed so the snow conditions can be challenging - if it's snowing or windy, check with us before you set out to make sure the trail's open that day.
sentences.zh: 这条道起始段沿着平缓的河谷延伸，但最后一段较为开阔暴露，因此雪况可能颇具挑战性——若遇降雪或大风天气，请出发前务必向我们确认当日该滑雪道是否开放。

sentences.en: Right, so now if you'd like to follow me, we'll get started
sentences.zh: 好的，那么现在如果您愿意跟我来，我们就马上开始
